issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: ResourceGroup for Azure resources and K8s namespaces

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

version.description: Specific version of Cloud Service to use

operatorResourceKind.description: Specific resource to create when creating a cloud service that uses an operator

managed.description: Specify if this Cloud Service is managed

certs.description: Tls Certificate if this Cloud Service needs a secure connection to be accessed

meta.description: Metadata of the CloudService; when started, started by who, etc

logicalImageRegistry.description: Logical registry to fetch CloudServices' Artifacts

doNotCleanupStorageOnTerminate.description:
If true, storage resources (such as PVCs) will not be cleaned up when the cloud service is terminated.
Default is false, meaning storage resources ARE cleaned up by default. Subtypes can override this.

NOTE: Preserved storage is currently not protected against orphan resource cleanup that is enabled on development clusters.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Number of minutes after which the service will be shutdown automatically if idle

istioEnabled.description: If set to true, Istio is enabled in this cluster.

authorizedUsers.description:
List of {@link User.id}s for users who have access to the corresponding {@link ExMachina} service. By default, this
list is populated with the id of the user who created the service. This value can be dynamically updated when the
service is already running to grant/revoke access mid-session.

exmacServiceAccountToken.description: The service account token used by the spark driver to create executor pods

exmacResourceNamePrefix.description: The unique identifier for resources created for a deployment of {@link ExMachina}

exmacCloudServiceId.description: The id of the ExMachina service. Used by the Spark server to authenticate with c3server

exmacServiceEndpoints.description:
ExMachina service endpoint. Useful during testing, e.g. on local development setups where c3server resides on the
host machine while the service resides in K8s.

exmacDriverImageRepository.description: Image Repository to use for ExMachina

exmacDriverImageTag.description: Image Tag to use for ExMachina

exmacVadOAuth.description:
If set to true, use OAuth for outgoing requests from ExMachina service to c3server.
If false / undefined, the incoming c3auth token will be used.
ExMachina must execute some actions on behalf of the user, so ACL lets correct subset of records through in fetch(),
so we are not going to use OAuth (service) tokens. Instead we use the user (incoming) token when talking to c3server.

exmacVadFixedAuth.description:
If set to true, skip authentication using c3 context.
Used for debugging and internal development.

exmacK8sMasterEndpoint.description:
K8S master endpoint, usually the default is correct, but if it needs to be overridden
the current cluster value can be inferred via `kubectl cluster-info`

exmacDynamicResourceAllocation.description:
spark.dynamicAllocation.enabled
Enable Spark dynamic resource allocation. Note that the 'minExecutors', 'maxExecutors', 'executorTimeoutSeconds', 'executorAllocationRatio'
attributes will not have an effect unless this is enabled.

exmacMinExecutors.description:
spark.dynamicAllocation.minExecutors
The minimum number of executors that will be active at any time. Note that this will override 'exmacExecutorInstances'.

exmacMaxExecutors.description:
spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors
The maximum number of executors that can be active at any time. Note that this will override 'exmacExecutorInstances'.

exmacExecutorTimeoutSeconds.description:
spark.dynamicAllocation.executorIdleTimeout | spark.dynamicAllocation.cachedExecutorIdleTimeout
How long, in seconds, an executor can be idle before shutting down.

exmacExecutorAllocationRatio.description:
spark.dynamicAllocation.executorAllocationRatio
This many tasks will be assigned to each executor at a time. If there is tasks remaining, more executors will be provisioned.

additionalConfig.description:
comma separated string representation of additional spark config.
e.g. "spark.app.name=test,spark.driver.maxResultSize=2g"

exmacStartH2O.description:
Whether to start H2O Sparkling Water
ExMachina will start by default

exmacVadDefaultLimit.description:
spark.vad.c3.exmacVadDefaultLimit
Controls the default limit when accessing C3 Types. c3vad/vad/src/c3/vad/commons/Config.scala specifies
a value to use when this parameter is not passed.

exmacCertSecretTrustStorePassword.description: Note that because of how extraJavaOptions is passed, this password will be shown in plaintext in the Spark details

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: If K8s readOnlyRootFilesystem will be true, set this to true to start the Spark pods accordingly

exmacVadClassPath.description: Additional path to add to the Java classpath (for logging configuration, etc.)

exmacVadJarPath.description: The VAD jar to start with the Spark service

exmacExtraJavaOptions.description: Extra Java options. Useful for tuning and for debugging. e.g. "-XX:+UnlockDiagnosticVMOptions"

c3ServerEndpoint.description: Full {@link AppUrl} for C3 application server

runAsUser.description: The K8sPodSecurityContext.runAsUser to provide to the K8s deployment

runAsGroup.description: The K8sPodSecurityContext.runAsGroup to provide to the K8s deployment

fsGroup.description: The K8sPodSecurityContext.fsGroup to provide to the K8s deployment

executorPodLabels.description:
CloudService tags that would be set on singleuser server and it's resources.

This field automatically populated by {@link ExMachina.ensureConfig}.

sparkMetricsEnabled.description: Whether to enable metrics for spark from exmachina Service. Enabled by default

sparkMetricsInterval.description: Time interval for collecting spark metrics. Default interval is 60s
